channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Dangote signs $1B deal with Chinese firm to expand projects across seven African countries
item.description: Dangote Cement Plc (DCP), a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited, has signed a $1 billion agreement with China’s Sinoma International Engineering to construct new plants and expand existing facilities across Africa.

item.title: Nigeria joins Africa’s alumina race with new $1.3B refinery deal
item.description: Nigeria is accelerating efforts to diversify its economy away from crude oil after the Federal Government signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding with the African Finance Corporation (AFC) to jointly fund three strategic mining projects, including a $1.3 billion alumina refinery.

item.title: China overtakes South Africa as world’s top chrome processor amid soaring power costs
item.description: South Africa has lost its long-held position as the world’s leading processor of chrome into ferrochrome to China, as surging electricity prices continue to batter the country’s energy-intensive smelting sector.

item.title: Half of Africa’s oil to the U.S. comes from one country, as the U.S. cuts African oil imports
item.description: A new report has revealed that Nigeria, Africa’s top oil producer, is responsible for 52% of Africa’s crude exports to the United States.

item.title: Nigeria bets on gas-powered mobility with campus refuelling as $575 billion investment plan begins
item.description: Nigeria has taken another step in its push towards cleaner transport after the Midstream and Downstream Gas Infrastructure Fund commissioned a new compressed natural gas facility at Obafemi Awolowo University in Ile-Ife.

item.title: Ghana to reduce palm import by $200 million with new China alliance
item.description: Ghana is intensifying efforts to cut its palm oil import bill by about $200 million annually, as it courts Chinese investors to support an ambitious agricultural transformation drive.

item.title: Dangote Cement posts record profit of over $700m, targets expansion in South Africa, Ethiopia, and other markets
item.description: Nigeria’s Dangote Cement, Africa’s largest cement maker, delivered a historic financial performance in 2025 with profit after tax more than doubling to approximately ₦1.01 trillion naira, or about $743 million at prevailing exchange rates.

item.title: Zimbabwe claims top spot in South Africa’s tourism sector with over 2M yearly visitors
item.description: In a stunning realignment of regional travel dynamics, Zimbabwe has officially overtaken established global tourism heavyweights to become South Africa’s leading source of visitors.

item.title: AXIAN gets Comoros licence for new fully digital lender
item.description: AXIAN Group, the pan-African conglomerate owned by Madagascar billionaire Hassanein Hiridjee, has secured a Decentralized Digital Financial Institution (DFI) licence from the Central Bank of Comoros. The approval clears the way for AXIAN to launch a fully digital, regulated lender designed to bring formal financial services to some of the hardest-to-reach areas of Comoros.

item.title: A massive Asian-backed $9.8 billion AI project is set for South Africa, but governance concerns are mounting
item.description: A $9.8 billion (R159 billion) AI project led by South Korean Power Consortium aims to make South Africa a major digital hub, enhancing AI research and data infrastructure, though governance and oversight concerns are already surfacing
